paragraphs.text: translated by
1. DEAR, ageless sacrificial drink is offered in light-discovering, heaven-pervading Agni.
paragraphs.original: हविष्पान्तमजरं स्वर्विदि दिविस्पृश्याहुतं जुष्टमग्नौ ।
paragraphs.translit: haviṣpāntamajaraṃ svarvidi divispṛśyāhutaṃ juṣṭamagnau |

paragraphs.text: The Gods spread forth through his Celestial Nature, that he might bear the world up and sustain it.
paragraphs.original: तस्य भर्मणे भुवनाय देवा धर्मणे कं स्वधया पप्रथन्त
paragraphs.translit: tasya bharmaṇe bhuvanāya devā dharmaṇe kaṃ svadhayā paprathanta

paragraphs.text: 2. The world was swallowed and concealed in darkness: Agni was born, and light became apparent.
paragraphs.original: गीर्णं भुवनं तमसापगूळ्हमाविः स्वरभवज्जाते अग्नौ ।
paragraphs.translit: gīrṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ tamasāpagūḷhamāviḥ svarabhavajjāte agnau |

paragraphs.text: The Deities, the broad earth, and the heavens, and plants, and waters gloried in his friendship.
paragraphs.original: तस्य देवाः पृथिवी द्यौरुतापोऽरणयन्नोषधीः सख्ये अस्य
paragraphs.translit: tasya devāḥ pṛthivī dyaurutāpo'raṇayannoṣadhīḥ sakhye asya

paragraphs.text: 3. Inspired by Gods who claim our adoration, I now will laud Eternal Lofty Agni,
paragraphs.original: देवेभिर्न्विषितो यज्ञियेभिरग्निं स्तोषाण्यजरं बृहन्तम् ।
paragraphs.translit: devebhirnviṣito yajñiyebhiragniṃ stoṣāṇyajaraṃ bṛhantam |

paragraphs.text: Him who hath spread abroad the earth with lustre, this heaven, and both the worlds, and air's mid-region.
paragraphs.original: यो भानुना पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामाततान रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम्
paragraphs.translit: yo bhānunā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmātatāna rodasī antarikṣam

paragraphs.text: 4. Earliest Priest whom all the Gods accepted, and chose him, and anointed him with butter,
paragraphs.original: यो होतासीत्प्रथमो देवजुष्टो यं समाञ्जन्नाज्येना वृणानाः ।
paragraphs.translit: yo hotāsītprathamo devajuṣṭo yaṃ samāñjannājyenā vṛṇānāḥ |

paragraphs.text: He swiftly made all things that fly, stand, travel, all that hath motion, Agni Jatavedas.
paragraphs.original: स पतत्रीत्वरं स्था जगद्यच्छ्वात्रमग्निरकृणोज्जातवेदाः
paragraphs.translit: sa patatrītvaraṃ sthā jagadyacchvātramagnirakṛṇojjātavedāḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Because thou, Agni, Jatavedas, stoodest at the world's head with thy refulgent splendour,
paragraphs.original: यज्जातवेदो भुवनस्य मूर्धन्नतिष्ठो अग्ने सह रोचनेन ।
paragraphs.translit: yajjātavedo bhuvanasya mūrdhannatiṣṭho agne saha rocanena |

paragraphs.text: We sent thee forth with hymns and songs and praises: thou filledst heaven and earth, God meet for worship.
paragraphs.original: तं त्वाहेम मतिभिर्गीर्भिरुक्थैः स यज्ञियो अभवो रोदसिप्राः
paragraphs.translit: taṃ tvāhema matibhirgīrbhirukthaiḥ sa yajñiyo abhavo rodasiprāḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Head of the world is Agni in the night-time; then, as the Sun, at morn springs up and rises.
paragraphs.original: मूर्धा भुवो भवति नक्तमग्निस्ततः सूर्यो जायते प्रातरुद्यन् ।
paragraphs.translit: mūrdhā bhuvo bhavati naktamagnistataḥ sūryo jāyate prātarudyan |

paragraphs.text: Then to his task goes the prompt Priest foreknowing the wondrous power of Gods who must be honoured.
paragraphs.original: मायामू तु यज्ञियानामेतामपो यत्तूर्णिश्चरति प्रजानन्
paragraphs.translit: māyāmū tu yajñiyānāmetāmapo yattūrṇiścarati prajānan

paragraphs.text: 7. Lovely is he who, kindled in his greatness, hath shone forth, seated in the heavens, refulgent.
paragraphs.original: दृशेन्यो यो महिना समिद्धोऽरोचत दिवियोनिर्विभावा ।
paragraphs.translit: dṛśenyo yo mahinā samiddho'rocata diviyonirvibhāvā |

paragraphs.text: With resonant hymns all Gods who guard our bodies have offered up oblation in this Agni.
paragraphs.original: तस्मिन्नग्नौ सूक्तवाकेन देवा हविर्विश्व आजुहवुस्तनूपाः
paragraphs.translit: tasminnagnau sūktavākena devā havirviśva ājuhavustanūpāḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. First the Gods brought the hymnal into being; then they engendered Agni, then oblation.
paragraphs.original: सूक्तवाकं प्रथममादिदग्निमादिद्धविरजनयन्त देवाः ।
paragraphs.translit: sūktavākaṃ prathamamādidagnimādiddhavirajanayanta devāḥ |

paragraphs.text: He was their sacrifice that guards our bodies: him the heavens know, the earth, the waters know him.
paragraphs.original: स एषां यज्ञो अभवत्तनूपास्तं द्यौर्वेद तं पृथिवी तमापः
paragraphs.translit: sa eṣāṃ yajño abhavattanūpāstaṃ dyaurveda taṃ pṛthivī tamāpaḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. He, Agni, whom the Gods have generated, in whom they offered up all worlds and creatures,
paragraphs.original: यं देवासोऽजनयन्ताग्निं यस्मिन्नाजुहवुर्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ devāso'janayantāgniṃ yasminnājuhavurbhuvanāni viśvā |

paragraphs.text: He with his bright glow heated earth and heaven, urging himself right onward in his grandeur.
paragraphs.original: सो अर्चिषा पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामृजूयमानो अतपन्महित्वा
paragraphs.translit: so arciṣā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmṛjūyamāno atapanmahitvā

paragraphs.text: 10. Then by the laud the Gods engendered Agni in heaven, who fills both worlds through strength and vigour.
paragraphs.original: स्तोमेन हि दिवि देवासो अग्निमजीजनञ्छक्तिभी रोदसिप्राम् ।
paragraphs.translit: stomena hi divi devāso agnimajījanañchaktibhī rodasiprām |

paragraphs.text: They made him to appear in threefold essence: he ripens plants of every form and nature.
paragraphs.original: तमू अकृण्वन्त्रेधा भुवे कं स ओषधीः पचति विश्वरूपाः
paragraphs.translit: tamū akṛṇvantredhā bhuve kaṃ sa oṣadhīḥ pacati viśvarūpāḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. What time the Gods, whose due is worship, set him as Surya, Son of Aditi, in heaven,
paragraphs.original: यदेदेनमदधुर्यज्ञियासो दिवि देवाः सूर्यमादितेयम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yadedenamadadhuryajñiyāso divi devāḥ sūryamāditeyam |

paragraphs.text: When the Pair, ever wandering, sprang to being, all creatures that existed looked upon them.
paragraphs.original: यदा चरिष्णू मिथुनावभूतामादित्प्रापश्यन्भुवनानि विश्वा
paragraphs.translit: yadā cariṣṇū mithunāvabhūtāmāditprāpaśyanbhuvanāni viśvā

paragraphs.text: 12. For all the world of life the Gods made Agni Vaisvanara to be the days' bright Banner,-
paragraphs.original: विश्वस्मा अग्निं भुवनाय देवा वैश्वानरं केतुमह्नामकृण्वन् ।
paragraphs.translit: viśvasmā agniṃ bhuvanāya devā vaiśvānaraṃ ketumahnāmakṛṇvan |

paragraphs.text: Him who hath spread abroad the radiant Mornings, and, coming with his light, unveils the darkness.
paragraphs.original: आ यस्ततानोषसो विभातीरपो ऊर्णोति तमो अर्चिषा यन्
paragraphs.translit: ā yastatānoṣaso vibhātīrapo ūrṇoti tamo arciṣā yan

paragraphs.text: 13. The wise and holy Deities engendered Agni Vaisvanara whom age ne'er touches.
paragraphs.original: वैश्वानरं कवयो यज्ञियासोऽग्निं देवा अजनयन्नजुर्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: vaiśvānaraṃ kavayo yajñiyāso'gniṃ devā ajanayannajuryam |

paragraphs.text: The Ancient Star that wanders on for ever, lofty and. strong, Lord of the Living Being.
paragraphs.original: नक्षत्रं प्रत्नममिनच्चरिष्णु यक्षस्याध्यक्षं तविषं बृहन्तम्
paragraphs.translit: nakṣatraṃ pratnamaminaccariṣṇu yakṣasyādhyakṣaṃ taviṣaṃ bṛhantam

paragraphs.text: 14. We call upon the Sage with holy verses, Agni Vaisvanara the ever-beaming,
paragraphs.original: वैश्वानरं विश्वहा दीदिवांसं मन्त्रैरग्निं कविमच्छा वदामः ।
paragraphs.translit: vaiśvānaraṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsaṃ mantrairagniṃ kavimacchā vadāmaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Who hath surpassed both heaven and earth in greatness: lie is a God below, a God above us.
paragraphs.original: यो महिम्ना परिबभूवोर्वी उतावस्तादुत देवः परस्तात्
paragraphs.translit: yo mahimnā paribabhūvorvī utāvastāduta devaḥ parastāt

paragraphs.text: 15. I have heard mention of two several pathways, ways of the Fathers and of Gods and mortals.
paragraphs.original: द्वे स्रुती अशृणवं पितॄणामहं देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: dve srutī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṝṇāmahaṃ devānāmuta martyānām |

paragraphs.text: On these two paths each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.
paragraphs.original: ताभ्यामिदं विश्वमेजत्समेति यदन्तरा पितरं मातरं च
paragraphs.translit: tābhyāmidaṃ viśvamejatsameti yadantarā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca

paragraphs.text: 16. These two united paths bear him who journeys born from the head and pondered with the spirit
paragraphs.original: द्वे समीची बिभृतश्चरन्तं शीर्षतो जातं मनसा विमृष्टम् ।
paragraphs.translit: dve samīcī bibhṛtaścarantaṃ śīrṣato jātaṃ manasā vimṛṣṭam |

paragraphs.text: He stands directed to all things existing, hasting, unresting in his fiery splendour.
paragraphs.original: स प्रत्यङ्विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थावप्रयुच्छन्तरणिर्भ्राजमानः
paragraphs.translit: sa pratyaṅviśvā bhuvanāni tasthāvaprayucchantaraṇirbhrājamānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 17. Which of us twain knows where they speak together, upper and lower of the two rite-leaders?
paragraphs.original: यत्रा वदेते अवरः परश्च यज्ञन्योः कतरो नौ वि वेद ।
paragraphs.translit: yatrā vadete avaraḥ paraśca yajñanyoḥ kataro nau vi veda |

paragraphs.text: Our friends have helped to gather our assembly. They came to sacrifice; who will announce it?
paragraphs.original: आ शेकुरित्सधमादं सखायो नक्षन्त यज्ञं क इदं वि वोचत्
paragraphs.translit: ā śekuritsadhamādaṃ sakhāyo nakṣanta yajñaṃ ka idaṃ vi vocat

paragraphs.text: 18. How many are the Fires and Suns in number? What is the number of the Dawns and Waters?
paragraphs.original: कत्यग्नयः कति सूर्यासः कत्युषासः कत्यु स्विदापः ।
paragraphs.translit: katyagnayaḥ kati sūryāsaḥ katyuṣāsaḥ katyu svidāpaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Not jestingly I speak to you, O Fathers. Sages, I ask you this for information.
paragraphs.original: नोपस्पिजं वः पितरो वदामि पृच्छामि वः कवयो विद्मने कम्
paragraphs.translit: nopaspijaṃ vaḥ pitaro vadāmi pṛcchāmi vaḥ kavayo vidmane kam

paragraphs.text: 19. As great as is the fair-winged Morning's presence to him who dwells beside us, Matarisvan!
paragraphs.original: यावन्मात्रमुषसो न प्रतीकं सुपर्ण्यो वसते मातरिश्वः ।
paragraphs.translit: yāvanmātramuṣaso na pratīkaṃ suparṇyo vasate mātariśvaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Is what the Brahman does when he approaches to sacrifice and sits below the Hotar.
paragraphs.original: तावद्दधात्युप यज्ञमायन्ब्राह्मणो होतुरवरो निषीदन्
paragraphs.translit: tāvaddadhātyupa yajñamāyanbrāhmaṇo hoturavaro niṣīdan
